beginner.script: Welcome to your Beginner Chair Yoga session. Settle near a stable chair with both feet supported. Move gently within a range that feels comfortable today.

intermediate.script: Welcome to your Intermediate Chair Yoga session. Arrange your chair securely and follow each movement at your own pace. Keep your range comfortable and your breath steady.

advanced.script: Welcome to your Advanced Chair Yoga session. Keep your chair close and use the support shown. Choose a steady, comfortable range and pause whenever you need.

beginner.script: Your Beginner Chair Yoga session is complete. Let your breathing settle. When ready, return to standing slowly with your chair nearby.

intermediate.script: Your Intermediate Chair Yoga session is complete. Take a moment to breathe naturally, then leave each position carefully and use your chair for support.

advanced.script: Your Advanced Chair Yoga session is complete. Let your breath return to its natural pace. Move slowly and keep the chair close as you finish.
